.. exception:: InvalidWriteError

   Raised by :meth:`ConfigParser.write` when an option name begins with
   the parser's section-header pattern or contains one of its configured
   delimiters. These checks apply to defaults and named sections. They do
   not promise that every custom parser configuration round-trips, or that
   the output stream is unchanged when writing fails.

.. exception:: MultilineContinuationError
